evidence: Frozen workbook Quality Checks!C39:D39 requires scored prompts to score each criterion separately and continue after a failure; Internal Quality Checks!C39:D39 agrees. All three scored judge.toml files use mode="batched" and aggregation="weighted_mean" (82 functional, 6 polish, 6 visual criteria). Functional prompt.md:5 limits dimension-wide zero to the global browser gate and says ordinary failures remain local; :9 says every row gets its own result even on failure; :11 says continue unrelated evidence; :100 forbids sibling verdict prerequisites; :112 forbids cascading failures. Polish prompt.md:20-22 reserves all-zero for the global prerequisite and says ordinary failures do not zero unrelated criteria; :36-40 requires a verdict for every criterion after failure. Visual prompt.md:38-40 reserves all-zero for the global prerequisite; :52-56 requires independent scoring and continuation. The 94 parsed criterion descriptions contain no stop-on-first-failure/all-zero instruction; see evidence/38/source-and-index-audit.json. Counterexample probes considered: a partially broken app missing Auto-run but with working save/history keeps separately observed non-Auto-run credit under functional :15,:100; an otherwise conforming app with one browser tool failure keeps unrelated observed credit under app_context.md:Evidence failures. Neither is directed to be zeroed by the failed row. The raw index has 77/77 matching artifact SHA256 values, but its scripted browser observations are not configured grading; this verdict is for source wording only.
